verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Trilegal has an AI *practice area* advising clients on AI-related legal issues (IP, employment, data privacy) and a GenAI regulatory whitepaper, plus a DPDPA compliance tool — but none of this describes how the firm itself uses AI in its own client-service delivery (e.g., AI-assisted drafting, review, or internal AI policy). The DPDPA tool is not documented as AI-powered, and no named internal AI tools or AI-use policies are disclosed.
